articles.title: THORChain rejects Bitget request to block hacker as $6 million moves to bitcoin
articles.snippet: CoinDesk found 27 successful swaps moving about 2,390 ETH into 75.2 BTC, even as Bitget urged THORChain to stop serving addresses tied to the $387.5 million theft.

articles.title: Bitget resumes Bitcoin withdrawals as hacker swaps ETH via THORChain
articles.snippet: Ether withdrawals are scheduled to return Tuesday and USDt on Wednesday as Bitget restores services following last week’s $388 million hack.

articles.title: THORChain under fire over Bitget, ETH evolves beyond blockchain: Hodler’s Digest
articles.snippet: THORChain refuses to blacklist addresses linked to the Bitget hack. Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum is evolving from being a mere blockchain, into a world cryptographic computer.
